name: Ample Classes Are Strictly Zonotopally Realizable COMs
scope: Finite simple COMs and their tope graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every finite ample class is a zonotopally realizable COM, and the containment is strict.
proof: Lopsided systems admit compatible zonotopal realizations. The cycle $C_6$ is a realizable oriented-matroid tope graph and hence zonotopally realizable, but an antipodal ample partial cube must be a hypercube.
